excluded_majors.notes: Local folder holds only MA IB&M curricula; note Excel scope flags severe English course limit for UG Business ('only 3 courses in english for UG').

min_gpa_host.notes: MCI does not enforce a strict university-wide minimum GPA cutoff; academic eligibility/GPA is vetted by home university at nomination (mci4me.at).

english_course_availability.notes: Excel scope explicitly warns 'only 3 courses in english for UG' in Business; graduate MA IB&M offers broader English modules.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 minimum for Bachelor (e.g., TOEFL iBT 75, IELTS 5.5, or passing MCI online English test); CEFR C1 for Master.

host_language_requirement.value: German required only if enrolling in German-taught courses.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Semester: Sep 2 - Dec 22, 2026 (select Bachelor programmes e.g. Entrepreneurship/Tourism & Leisure; Social/Health/Public Mgmt) OR Oct 1, 2026 - Feb 20, 2027 (all other programmes); incl. orientation & initial exams.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Semester: Mar 2 - Jun 30, 2027 across all programmes (Excel also notes Mar-Jun).

tuition_model.notes: Partner-nominated bilateral/Erasmus exchange students receive a tuition waiver at MCI.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Exact numeric monthly EUR living budget did not trace cleanly to mci.edu/mci4me.at citations (ungrounded summary ranges excluded).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No mci.edu/mci4me.at-verified monthly living budget figure.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Austrian Student Union (ÖH) membership + MCI administrative fee totaling approx. EUR 50 per semester (includes basic accident/liability insurance).

housing_availability.notes: Competitive Innsbruck rental market; MCI accommodation portal at https://international.mci.edu/en/students/international-exchange-students/accommodation guides applicants (OeAD/ISH partner details traced to 3rd-party sheets).

housing_notes.value: Consult MCI incoming accommodation guide immediately upon nomination: https://international.mci.edu/en/students/international-exchange-students/accommodation.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students require Austrian Visa D or Residence Permit (Aufenthaltsbewilligung Student) depending on stay duration; apply early via Austrian Embassy using MCI acceptance docs.

english_course_list_url.notes: Official MCI English-taught courses & syllabi portal; note AUC Excel warning of only 3 English UG courses.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; up to 30 ECTS maximum per semester (no MCI minimum enforced, home university minimum applies).

course_restrictions_note.value: AUC Excel list flags 'only 3 courses in english for UG' in Business; MCI policy directs choosing modules from a single primary degree programme plus optional International Program courses (first-come, first-served).

value: English B2/C1 proficiency proof (standard test or MCI online English test)

international_support_services.value: MCI International Relations Office pre-arrival, visa, housing, and online English test guidance.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall/Winter semester: Nomination Apr 1, Application May 1 (some guidelines extend to May 15); Spring/Summer semester: Nomination Oct 1, Application Nov 1 (up to Nov 15).
